description: Live spot price of gold (XAU) or silver (XAG) in USD per troy ounce from gold-api.com (aggregated free spot feed, no key). This is a spot quote with a timestamp, not the LBMA London AM/PM fixing and not vault holdings; the route name is kept for the owner. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_ammonia_fertilizer_spot when you need Monthly US producer price indexes for ammonia and nitrogen; energy_cme_agri_spot_futures when you need Monthly world reference prices for corn, wheat and soybeans. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_precious_metals_spot_fix
